title: UNBELTED Passenger in Frontal Car Crash
summary: IIHS frontal crash test footage showing what happens to an unbelted rear-seat passenger. It illustrates that buckling up in the back matters for the passenger and for front occupants.
why: Used as a visual example in seat belt and personal-freedom debates, showing an unbelted rear passenger becoming a projectile.

quote.text: If you're in the back seat of a car, without a seat belt, in a collision you may turn into a projectile
